recognize_zh: 箭頭標示一顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），旁邊有兩顆核摺疊、細胞質灰藍的單核球；兒童血液中單核球增多又見有核紅血球，是幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）常見的周邊血表現。
features: Arrow: nucleated red blood cell with small round pyknotic nucleus and orthochromatic cytoplasm
Two large monocytes with indented/folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Partial neutrophil at left edge with segmented nucleus
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, occasional stomatocyte-like and target forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a circulating nucleated red blood cell (arrow) adjacent to two monocytes with folded nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. A segmented neutrophil is present at the edge of the field. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis; no blasts are seen in this field. In a young child, monocytosis with circulating nucleated red cells is suggestive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: A leukoerythroblastic picture shows NRBCs with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells rather than a dominant monocytosis.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocytosis with hemolysis or stress erythropoiesis
ddx.vs: Reactive states can produce NRBCs and monocytes, but lack persistent monocytosis above 1 x 10^9/L with splenomegaly, elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations.
CMML is morphologically similar but occurs in older adults and lacks the prominent NRBCs and HbF elevation typical of JMML.
